other_conditions: Applicant must be a native of Madhya Pradesh
Applicant must own agricultural land within the state
Applicants from Shajapur and Indore districts are excluded
benefits_summary: 75% subsidy up to ₹25,000 for tube well digging and up to ₹15,000 for submersible pump installation.
application_link: Eligible farmers can apply for benefits under the scheme by visiting the office of the Deputy Director, Farmers Welfare and Agriculture Development Department in their respective district in Madhya Pradesh.
